name: Empire of Brazil

flag.description: A green field with a large yellow rhombus bearing the imperial arms: a green shield with a gold armillary sphere on the cross of the Order of Christ, ringed in blue with silver stars, framed by coffee and tobacco branches and topped by the imperial crown.
flag.symbolism: Green is said to represent Emperor Pedro I's House of Braganza and yellow Empress Maria Leopoldina's House of Habsburg; the stars stood for the provinces of the empire.

hook: Imperial Brazil already had the green field and yellow diamond, but with a crowned coat of arms where today's blue starry globe sits.
trivia: The flag was designed by the French painter Jean-Baptiste Debret.
When the monarchy fell in 1889, the republic kept the green and yellow and replaced the arms with a blue globe and the motto "Ordem e Progresso".
